_note: Pagoda animation: timings, speeds, easing and motion, one group per part of the stage (stage = the files at the pagoda root).

encounter._note: The encounter screens' motion and timing. Times are in seconds unless the key names another unit (_ms, _frames); angles name their unit (_deg, _rad). Each sub-group is one encounter file (folders nest: cutscenes, credits, bands, items).

corruption._note: Bits per second at full strength; lifetimes are [min, max] seconds. default_s / default_tail_s: start()'s defaults.

glitch._note: Ranges are [min, max] seconds, picked at random. burst_every_s is at rate 1; a burst redraws its slices every reslice_s; a voiced burst plays the glitch sound at sound_odds. A held ambient tile jumps by up to jump_px at jump_per_s chances per second.

level10._note: idle: the encounter/motion counter idle (period, squash). The emerge fades in over emerge_s from emerge_sink_px deep and is held emerge_beat_s more; the buildup loop fades in over build_fade_s and out over build_out_s under the reveal's slam; pop: the monster form's punch-in overshoot; the swirl gathers gather_beat_s after the sprite is gone; loom_grow is a scale share.

level20._note: Tobiraph bobs and sways about its eye (px over a period in seconds). *_fade_to, gleam_peak / gleam_rest and finial_under_bean are opacity levels 0-1. fade_from_s delays the backdrop's fade; after_rate: how often the corrupt figure still glitches (silently). away: the ascent. Shafts and the finial breathe between *_breath_min and *_breath_min + *_breath_amp (shaft_breath_rate in radians per second, shaft_phase_step per shaft). Ume fades out over ume_fade_share of ume_out_s after ume_fade_delay_share of it.

stair_air._note: Each ray breathes over its period and rocks by +-ray_sway_deg; the sun glow breathes by sun_breath_opacity. The forest_leaves preset (fx/presets) keeps about preset_leaves_aloft leaves aloft; the stair keeps leaves_aloft.

star._note: The figure shrinks into its eye over shrink_s (to 1 - figure_shrink of its size); the star pops at pop_at_s and flies off at fly_at_s by fly_dx_px and up to fly_to_y (screen space), shrinking by fly_shrink; busy until done_at_s. The trail sheds a sparkle every trail_every_s within trail_jitter_px, falling at trail_fall_px_per_s [min, max] and shrinking by trail_shrink over its life. The inner star turns at inner_spin_share of the spin, the other way.

storm._note: The strikes repeat every cycle_s: at at_s, a flash of flash_opacity, with a far bolt and the near clap when bolt is true (the others rumble far off). flash_env: the flash rises to 1 over rise_s, dips to dip at dip_at_s, comes back to back at back_at_s, then fades out by flash_s. Rain speeds are [min, max] px per second per depth (far, near); slant is rain dx per dy. A gust rises over gust_rise_s and falls over gust_fall_s, the clouds going cloud_gust_speedup times as fast at its height; calm slows the clouds by calm_cloud_slow.

checkpoint._note: On a first clear the darkness scatters over scatter_s while the room crossfades to clear from crossfade_at_s over crossfade_s; clearBusy() holds clear_tail_s after both. Shafts breathe between shaft_breath_min and shaft_breath_min + shaft_breath_amp over their periods; each lantern's flicker is offset by lantern_flicker_phase_step.

forest._note: Per variant: trail, stair. Each ray breathes over its period and rocks by +-ray_sway_deg; the sun glow breathes by sun_breath_opacity. The forest_leaves preset (fx/presets) keeps about preset_leaves_aloft leaves aloft; each variant keeps leaves_aloft.

pagoda._note: tint_breath: share of the room's tint that follows the firelight. The returned overlay fades in after lost_delay_s over lost_fade_s; the open door over door_fade_s. Shafts breathe between shaft_breath_min and shaft_breath_min + shaft_breath_amp over their periods.

sky._note: wisps_vx_px_per_s: the wisps' [min, max] drift; cloud_px_per_s: each cloud row's drift, the far row first.

view._note: The background's push-in: from push_from_scale at reset to 1 over push_s.

band_label._note: The name pops in (from pop_from_scale, Easing.outBack overshoot pop_overshoot, over pop_s), the number number_delay_s later. rainbow_speed: the roof floors' rainbow.

clear._note: CLEAR!: a letter every pop_every_s pops over pop_s from pop_from_scale (Easing.outBack overshoot pop_overshoot), dropping pop_drop_px and turning back from pop_tilt_deg, alternating; its glitter bursts (glitter_burst sparkles) at pop_land_share of the pop; it fades in over fade_in_share of the pop. The spin wave starts wave_at_s after the last pop, a letter every wave_every_s, each hopping wave_hop_px and tucking in by wave_shrink; shown() rest_s after it. Letters bob by bob_px at bob_hz, phase bob_phase_step apart.

fail._note: FAILED...: a letter every fall_every_s falls over fall_s from fall_from_px above its rest, fading in over fade_in_share of the fall, then bounces for bounce_s (a hop of bounce_px decaying at hop_decay, a squash of squash springing at spring_freq half-turns per bounce decaying at spring_decay, a wobble of land_wobble_deg at land_wobble_freq half-turns decaying at land_wobble_decay). Per letter: tilt at rest (deg), drop at rest (px) and the extra turn it falls with (deg). At rest it wobbles by wobble_deg at wobble_hz, phase wobble_phase_step apart.

fade._note: The word fades out over fade_s; CLEAR! swells by grow, FAILED... sags by sink_px.

items._note: Ume's items. Times in seconds; _hz are cycles per second; a _freq is the argument of a sin per second (radians per second); _back is the Easing outBack / inBack amount; a [min, max] pair is a random range.

charm._note: The drop falls from drop_from_y (stretching, thinning, its trail rising and growing), splashes, and rings spread out at their speeds, slowing by ring_slow over their life. rings: delay after the splash, peak opacity, speed in px per second; the first ring's speed times the reveals.

splash._note: The splash's drops: count, speed range, spread in degrees either side of straight up, gravity in px per second squared, life and size ranges; they shrink by shrink over their life.

icons._note: The icons pop in one after the other; a refilled one turns back to colour refill_delay_s after it is in. The focused icon's ring pulses by halo_pulse at halo_hz. A new item's burst: a ring growing from burst_ring_from_px by burst_ring_grow_px, glints flying out to burst_r_px while turning.

popup._note: The panel springs in from in_from (scale) and shrinks by out_shrink as it goes; decide closes it after hold_s. The item bobs, its halo pulses between halo_pulse_min and halo_pulse_min + halo_pulse, the glints orbit and twinkle.

tambourine._note: The tambourine pops up, shakes and shrinks away; waves ripple out (speed in px per second, slowing by wave_slow over their life, turning in degrees per second the other way every second wave, swelling by wave_breath) and glints orbit out to glint_r_px. The song bars sway at wobble_at_s and leave at leave_at_s; the screen jolts by screen_shake_px.

songbars._note: The bars float (px and degrees, _hz cycles per second, each bar's phase offset by its index times *_phase radians), slide in from the left and out to the left (x offsets in px, turns in degrees), sway in a wave (wobble) and pop a revealed name's letters in. label_at_s is after the last bar is in, badge_at_s after the label starts, destiny_beat_s after everything is in; load_wait_s is the longest a new roll's bars wait for their art.

speed_badge._note: The two arrows pulse at beat_bpm at x1 (scaled by the speed, the beat held between beat_min_ms and beat_max_ms), their opacity between arrow_min_opacity and arrow_min_opacity + arrow_pulse_opacity.

bar_flames._note: Flame tongues born at rate per second (at most max alive, at most spawn_backlog owed), in three zones: share of the births, rise in px per second, life in seconds and scale ranges, and where they are born in the bar's local px (inset from the edge, a random band). They lean up to lean_deg, sway sway_px at sway_hz, swell in (fade_in_k) and grow between *_min and *_min + grow; once stopped they age burn_out times faster. A new fire is run prewarm_s ahead at prewarm_fps.

ui_pill._note: The selected pill bounces by bounce_amp at bounce_freq (radians per second), the marker bobs marker_bob_px at marker_freq.

cast._note: The cast's run-in, landing, idle and walk-out. run_settle: the share of the run over which the waddle dies down; the skid leans the top back (left). land: a damped spring on the squash over s seconds plus a hop. The idle is a motion "counter" ramping in over idle.ramp_s. ume / student: when each one starts relative to the other, and its knockback launch.

cast_moves._note: Pose curves of the cast's moves. squash_widen: the share of a squash that widens; stretch_thin: the share of a stretch that thins. waddle: the run cycle's sharp tilt (sharpness shapes it) with a hop on every step. cheer: a wind-up squash, the hops, then a spring that dies into the idle. run: the run off-screen (diag: up the stairs; up: up the roof, shrinking up_shrink over up_shrink_px, its shadow gone after up_shadow_px). climb: brake to the door, turn, then steps hopping up and to the left (dx, dy) that shrink and fade from fade_at of the climb. knock: a hit-stop squash, then a spinning launch on a low arc.

destiny._note: Level 20's destiny sequence, in seconds from its start (pop_*, flavor_*, ping_at_s: from the shatter). Three cracks, each shaking the bar shake.px[i] decaying over shake.s (the sounds crack1..crack3 go with them). Shards: speeds at the zoomed scale, fading out from fade_from of their life and shrinking by shrink.

exclaim._note: The "!" bubble: pops up over pop_s, bobs while the line lasts, shrinks away over out_s.

monster._note: Seconds between one member's notice, charge or vanish and the next one's.

monsters._note: The monsters' idles (encounter/motion), by art key: counter = period_s and amp of the squash; float = hover_px and tilt_deg, or hover_mul scaling the whole float. pair: floor 6's norm4b and critter both wander range_px, the critter's idle clock running critter_tempo times as fast.

monster_body._note: The doors' monsters' glow pulses at base + pulse * sin(rad_per_s * t) of its opacity.

monster_moves._note: The monster's result-screen moves. charge: antic is the share of the charge spent winding up (pull_px back, back_deg, coil), then the rush leaning lean_deg (reached over lean_in of it) and stretching; hop: hops of hop_px, swoop: rise_px then dive_px; after the hit a recoil and a spring, the idle coming back from settle_s over blend_s. default_s / min_s: the charge's length when none is given / at least. squish: wide and low, then thin and tall (tall_overshoot), zipping up zip_px as it fades over s.

motion._note: Idle animations of the encounter actors. Every pose's scale stays between scale_min and scale_max; notice is a short pop. Chances and shares pick the next random move of an idle (looks only).

star._note: Bounces of height_px every period_s, squashing over contact of each bounce, tilting, and every spin_min_s..spin_max_s spinning through one airtime.

wander._note: Rests, then walks min_step_px..max_step_px or (hop_chance) hops hop_dx within range_px of its spot; after a move it may turn back (turn_chance) turn_delay_s into the rest. flip_*: the width springing back from flip_from as it turns.

counter._note: Squash-and-stretch in place: the default period_s and amp (a monster's params replace them), squashing over the first accent of each period and widening widen of the squash.

erratic._note: A glitching thing: a tremor of small angles held tremor_hold_s, and one glitch every gap_s. Ranges are [min, max]. shares: the chance of each glitch, in the order twitch, jitter, skip, stretch, freeze.

reveal._note: The monster's reveal: its eyes rise to eyes_peak by eyes_rise_s, settle to eyes_rest by eyes_settle_s (seconds into the line), then pulse; the body fades in after fade_delay_s, catch_up times faster when the player asks to advance.

scene._note: cover_s: the black cover's fade for a cover line without `sec`. rumble: a steady shake's wobble rates.

script._note: The dialog's typing speed and a voice blip every blip_every_chars characters.

shake._note: A screen shake dying down over its duration; default_px / default_s when a caller gives none.

credits._note: The end credits' backgrounds (encounter/credits/). Times in seconds; a scene's times count from when it starts fading in. Idle params are encounter/motion.lua's (P = period in s, A = amplitude).

actor._note: A turn: the width snaps to flip_from and springs back over flip_s, as a wandering monster turning (encounter/motion.lua).

backdrop._note: Roll seconds each scene starts fading in (hug, forest, watch, chase, fall, loading, beanstalk), and how long each takes to fade into the next.

beanstalk._note: The light shafts flicker between shaft_flicker_base - amp and base + amp (frequency in radians per second, each shaft phase_step radians on); the finial breathes between breath_base - amp and base + amp at finial_breath_hz.

chase._note: descent: coming down the stairs, the climb through the door (encounter/cast_moves.lua) run backwards: steps hops over s seconds, travelling dx, dy px, shrinking by shrink, hop px high, tilting tilt deg, fading in after fade_at of it. walk_k is the run cycle's share in the walk, which eases in and out over walk_ease of it. chasers: when each norm3 comes down and when it starts the chase.

fall._note: The tumblers roll left along the treads at speed px/s, growing by accel px/s^2; each bounce takes bounce_s and squashes by squash (widening by squash_widen of it) for squash_s where it meets a step, in a puff of dust_count motes. tumblers: start, spin (degrees/s, counter-clockwise: rolling left) and bounce height px, in the order of the Lua list of keys.

forest._note: walkers: px/s leftwards (used when the monster does not wander) and, when present, range, which widens a wanderer's walk around its x, in the order of the Lua list of keys. The ones whose idle stays in place bob step_px at step_hz. Rays sway ray_sway_deg and pulse between ray_opacity [min, max]; the sun breathes sun_breath around its opacity over sun_period_s.

hug._note: The picture grows by push over push_s (about the roll's length, set in credits.lua).

watch._note: spirits: start (seconds after the Student) and idle tempo, in the order of the Lua list of keys; they run at idle_weight of their idle and bound spirit_hop_px every spirit_hop_s; the Student's brake raises dust_count motes.

document._note: The roof monster, a floating window (encounter/document.lua). Now and then its box spins once, its eye looks at the player (to the left) and back, it blinks, and its neon crown lights up with a flicker, flashes while lit, and flickers out. [a, b] ranges are seconds picked at random each time; px are in the box art's pixels.

crown._note: flicker_s: the lighting flicker, segments alternately lit and dark starting lit; out_flicker_s: the going-out flicker, alternately dark and lit starting dark. hum: how much the lit tube dims and brightens, at hum_hz.

fx._note: The shared effects' motion and timing (fx/*). Times are in seconds unless the key names another unit; ranges are [min, max], picked at random; a _share is a fraction of a life or a run. Each sub-group is one fx file.

emitter._note: The emitter spawns at most spawn_backlog_max particles in one update to catch up, and simulates a prewarm at prewarm_steps_per_s. defaults: what a preset without life, sway freq, twinkle hz, fade or fin / fout gets. A flutter squeezes scale x down to flutter.base and back (base + amp * |cos|).

presets._note: Named emitter presets (the fields are listed in fx/emitter.lua); the texture each preset draws with is set in fx/presets.lua. Positions (area, zones: x, y, w, h; p is a zone's chance) are in 1920x1080 screen space, sizes are scales of the texture, speeds are px/s, gravity px/s per s, spin deg/s, life, prewarm, every, fin and fout seconds, sway freq and twinkle / turb hz in Hz. A sway, turb or twinkle given as rad_per_s instead is divided by 2 pi into Hz. colors and ramp are 0-1 RGB, alpha 0-1. Steady population is about rate x mean life; setRate scales it up to max.

forest_leaves._note: the trail keeps about 14 aloft; the stair band asks for 18 with setRate(18 / 14)

interior_dust._note: 70% of the motes hang in the window and door light

ceiling_specks._note: one burst of 12 from a random beam x along the area, every 4-8 s

divine_shine._note: the Tobiraph aura: half of 16/s each, 48 motes in total

door_dark._note: darkness seeping out of the doors' monsters (floors 11-19), drawn behind the body

glitter._note: sparkles around the CLEAR! letters; the banner sets the area and bursts one per letter

impact_spark._note: stars and sparks of the fail collision: one burst of about 18 at the hit point

guard_smoke._note: black wisps rising off the level-10 guardian as it turns black; the cutscene places each puff

darkness._note: Per visible box: per_s motes and spirals, spawning at most backlog_max in one update, up to max_particles in all. Motes and spirals rise at rise_px_per_s (world px/s) and swirl sideways at swirl.px_per_s on a phase turning at swirl.rad_per_s; spirals spin at spin_deg_per_s in a random direction. The bank drifts by drift_px and its puffs sway by sway_px (half that vertically). A scatter: particles within reach_px of the box rise at rise_px_per_s, are pushed sideways at push_px_per_s and age life_drain times faster; the bank's puffs spread by cloud_spread and rise cloud_rise_px as scatter goes 0 -> 1.

light._note: flicker: base plus, for each wave i = 1, 2, 3, wave_amps[i] * sin(wave_rad_per_s[i] * t + i * seed). The grain jumps grain_steps_per_s times a second. rays: the defaults of a ray entry without period / phase / aMin / aMax (default_phase_step times its index); the sway runs on sway_period_ratio times the period at sway_phase_ratio times the phase.

dissolve._note: dark_s to the black silhouette; the front starts at eat_from_s and runs top to bottom in eat_s, its speed easing as u * (front_ease.base + front_ease.amp * u). The front's raggedness: two waves drifting sideways (amp, waves across the sprite, waves per second), a fixed jitter per strip and a flicker per strip at column_flicker_hz (base + jitter * random). grain and haze: what a silhouette point sheds when the front passes it (count_base of each, plus one at extra_chance); size_end scales the size over the life, fade_out_share is the share of the life spent fading out. The dust drifts right on wind_px_per_s, is pulled up by rise_px_per_s2, loses drag_per_s of its speed per second and flutters sideways at turb_px_per_s on turb_hz.

dust_trail._note: speck and smoke: what a point sheds into the swirl (count_base of each, plus one at extra_chance); ghost: whether a flying piece has a ghost copy. puff: a soft puff left where a point is shed, at chance, rising at rise_px_per_s. The swirl: a piece falls onto its radius with time constant pull_s, at most pull_max_px_per_s; it turns at spin_rad_per_s (negative: the left side runs down) at spin_r_px, faster nearer the middle (counted from at least spin_min_radius_px), at most spin_max_rad_per_s, at spin_jitter.base + spin_jitter.jitter * random of that; it bobs by bob.px at bob.hz, reaching the full bob in bob.in_s. The trail: release_s from the first piece leaving to the last, each piece runs fly_s along the curve, speeding up into the end (u = k ^ accel), spending join_share of the run joining the curve; the slither is wave.amp_px, wave.along waves along the curve moving wave.per_s waves a second, under a sin ^ envelope_power envelope. A piece fades out after fade_from_share of its run and loses shrink_share of its size by the end; the ghost lags ghost_lag_s behind.

fire._note: The core's squash flicker and lean: scale x times 1 + squash_x.amp * sin(rad_per_s * t), scale y times 1 + the two squash_y waves (the first shifted by its phase), a lean of lean.deg on its own sine.

impact._note: The ouch burst pops in pop_s from pop_from_scale with an outBack overshoot of pop_overshoot (fading in over pop_fade_in_share of the pop), holds hold_s, then fades out in out_s while growing by out_grow_scale. It tilts by up to +-tilt_deg; sparks: the burst of the impact_spark preset.

play_bg._note: The play screen's upper background. Times in seconds; periods are one full sine cycle in seconds; speeds in px per second. Emitter groups (named after their fx/presets preset) replace those fields of the preset: rate_per_s (spawns per second), life_s [min, max], prewarm_s, vx_px_per_s [min, max].

flash._note: The monster's white flash as a note lands: it starts at the hit's opacity (0-1; a hit never lowers a brighter flash still fading) and fades out over duration_s.

beat._note: An idle cycle runs over the power of two of beats nearest its own length, kept within these.

checkpoint._note: shaft_breath: each shaft's opacity is base + amp * sin over its period.

forest._note: Each god ray breathes between ray_opacity_min and ray_opacity_max over its period and rocks by +-ray_sway_deg. The sun glow breathes by +-breath_opacity.

pagoda._note: shaft_breath: each shaft's opacity is base + amp * sin over its period.

roof._note: cloud_speed_px_per_s: the drift of each cloud row (far row first).

storm._note: settle_s: seconds of encounter view time run at once so its push-in is settled.

tobiraph._note: As in encounter/cutscenes/level20.lua: the bob (on the beat) and the sway, amplitude in px and period in seconds.

stage._note: Timings and motion of the stage's own screens (the root .lua files), in seconds and 1920x1080 pixels.

script._note: Script.lua. bgm_fade_s matches dan_doors_back's FADE_OUT_SECONDS / FADE_IN_SECONDS. sky_speed multiplies the day sky's clock (clouds and sun drift off it; 1:1 with real time feels static). The puchichara floats float_amp px on a sine that steps sine_steps_per_s degrees a second, and changes frame (of frames in its sheet) every frame_step_s.

pagoda._note: pagoda.lua: how long a status message shows (it fades over its last second)

selector._note: exp-smoothing rate of the tower scroll toward the selection

sky._note: skybox.lua: stiffness of the spring the sky's hour glides on toward a new floor's (floor select, floor transition, back to the title); at 3.5 it is 80% there after 0.9 s, 99% after 1.8 s

confirm._note: selector_confirm.lua: the panel grows from open_from_scale while it fades in; Yes before the story fades to black over accept_fade_s; Yes before song_loading eases the panel out over close_s

floor_transition._note: floor_transition.lua: the beaten floor's darkness disperses (scatter_s), a beat so it reads before the camera moves (settle_s), the camera climbs (scroll_s), a beat to read the destination plaque (hold_s), the fade out (fade_s)

credits._note: credits.lua, seconds into the song: the first line comes up from the bottom edge at roll_start_s, the last line rests in the middle at roll_stop_s (the song's last chord) after slowing down over settle_s, the screen fades out at done_at_s. The roll starts with the song, or after song_wait_s without it. The picture darkens over bg_darken_s. Holding decide runs the roll fast times faster, easing in and out at speed_rate; a roll that comes to rest ahead_fade_s ahead of the song fades the song out until the end.

fail_flight._note: fail_flight.lua. talk_at_s: seconds into the flight before the lines start; hold_s: without lines, how long they tumble before dropping; land_beat_s: after they are out of sight, before the stomp; land_hold_s: after the stomp, before the landing is held (outlasts the shake); ring_fade_s: the stomp's ring fades out over the held landing. Scroll speeds are at full flight speed (px/s, to the right): the mountains (far to near), the sky pans (yaw) and its clouds drift along (cloud_drift times faster), and everything eases to a stop over ease_s once they drop. Each mountain starts at a random offset up to mountain_start_offset_max_px. Actors spin counter-clockwise, with a phase so the two never move in step and a lag behind the first one.

drop._note: leftward speed and acceleration, downward speed and gravity once they drop

floor_enter._note: floor_enter.lua: load_timeout_s: the screen starts even when the art is still loading; entrance_at_s: the cast's run-in start after the fade-in begins; a cutscene's opening animation holds the dialog cut_opening_max_s at most

floor_result._note: floor_result.lua: settle_s after the fade-in before the sequence starts; the banner stays up banner_beat_s once it has fully landed; lines_hold_s is held instead of the dialog when the floor has no lines; charge_s is the monster's rush to the cast; flown_beat_s after the cast has flown off, before the fade-out. timeouts: a step that never reports its end moves on after this long (come_in_s: the dark room's monster coming in with its light).

bestiary._note: bestiary.lua: the pop a newly selected card grows by, easing out over select_pop_s, and the panel's fade-in after a change; scroll_rate: how fast the description eases to its scroll (exp smoothing, per second).

selectui._note: The floor select's UI pieces. Times in seconds; overshoots are the Easing outBack amount.

carets._note: The chevrons bob outward by up to bob_px on a sine of bob_speed (radians per second), their scale pulsing by +-pulse_scale on the same sine.

hover._note: The border stays still. The sheen sweeps sheen_delay_s after a new selection, then once every sheen_period_s, taking sheen_s.

plaque._note: A new number pops in from pop_from_scale over pop_s. rainbow_speed: the roof rainbow's Rainbow.draw speed; glitter_rate_per_s: its glitter's sparkles per second.

story._note: Timings of the story layer: the VN player (story/vn.lua), the reaction flashes (story/react.lua), the background drift, the music fades (story/vn_music.lua) and the stage directions of the story scripts (story/entrance.lua, story/cutscenes). Times in seconds, shakes in pixels, opacities 0-1.

ume._note: A sprite enter/leave fades over fade_s. A face change: he squashes, springs back taller, then settles over bounce_s; squash_share is the deepest squash, as a share of his height (he widens by half of it).

typing._note: Typing speed of the box and the glyphs per typing blip.

shake_direction._note: The camera shake of a { shake = true } line.

react._note: The white flash of a reaction: it starts at peak_opacity and falls off over duration_s; shock also shakes the screen. Below min_visible_opacity the flash is not drawn.

backgrounds._note: Horizontal drift of a repeating background layer, px per second.

music._note: A loop fades in over fade_in_s, gives way to another over crossfade_s, and a scene's fade out never takes less than min_fade_out_s.

entrance._note: Seconds the floor's monster takes to fade in on a revealMonster line.

level10._note: The fail's black cover: its opacity and the seconds it takes to fade in.

title_ui._note: The title screen's UI pieces. Times in seconds.

shine._note: first_s before the first sweep, every_s between sweeps, sweep_s per sweep; the glitter trails the bars at glitter_rate_per_s sparkles per second.

towerfx._note: The floor-select ambience's motion (towerfx/*). Times are in seconds; ranges are [min, max], picked per particle; life_s is a particle's life before it respawns elsewhere; fade_in_share / fade_out_share are the shares of that life spent fading in and out. A wave is px (or deg) * sin(t * rad_per_s + phase); hz waves are in turns per second. A blink or glint is base + amp * sin(...). Each sub-group is one towerfx file.

checkpoint._note: Lantern i flickers (fx/light flicker) on seed i * flicker_seed_step. Sparks sway on sway and rise at rise_px_per_s.

doors._note: The door glow breathes between its opacities at rad_per_s, shifted level_phase per level; window shaft i breathes over period_s, shifted window_phase per window (and 1 per level). Dust sways on two waves, rises at rise_px_per_s and glints at a rate picked in glint.rad_per_s.

forest._note: Shafts breathe between their opacities over a period picked in period_s and rock by +-sway_deg over sway_period_ratio times it. Flies wander on three waves (phase_ratio times the fly's phase) and sink rise_px over a life. Leaves drift at vx / vy, sway, spin at spin_deg_per_s (random direction) and flip (scale x base + amp * |cos|) at flip.hz.

roofs._note: The night effects take over between the hours of night_hours. Clouds drift at speed_px_per_s and breathe between their opacities over a period picked in breath_period_s. Wind lines run at speed_px_per_s through their life, bobbing bob_px once. Stars twinkle at a rate picked in twinkle_rad_per_s.

stairs._note: Mist banks drift right at speed_px_per_s and breathe over a period picked in breath_period_s. Petals drift at vx / vy, sway, spin at spin_deg_per_s and flip at flip.hz. A flock crosses during the first flight_s of each gap (a gap picked in gap_s), sinking sink_px and bobbing bob_px; its wings flap at flap_hz through frames frames, each bird flap_phase_step behind the one before.
